title: Who was in the Vendome band: Stuff Smith, Jonah Jones, Luke Stewart
summary: Stuff Smith had the band at the Vendome, with Jonah Jones and Luke Stewart. Dicky Wells had already gone to New York, and she and Stuff did no comedy duets in those days.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. And at that time did Stuff ever get together with you and the two of you doing anything, a little jive or something or other the way you used to do later on?
You didn't do it in those days maybe?
No. But he was something else, that Stuff Smith.
Yeah. Was he fronting that band or who was fronting that band?
Well, I don't know who. He was front in one. Yeah, he had the band at the Vendome.
Yeah, and Jonah (Jones) was in it?
No, he had gone on to New York then maybe or something.
Yeah, he went before the rest of them did.
